objections.objection: The 1668x relative risk is mathematically fragile; a single additional failure in the reference group would reduce the RR to ~800x, and two additional failures would drop it below 400x, calling into question the stability of the signal.
objections.result: CB-B-0917: p < 1e-300 after testing 7 hypotheses; Bonferroni alpha 1.4e-3

objections.objection: The verdict attributes 93% of incidents to this batch, yet the raw failure rate (841/10k) suggests most units in the batch survived; the proportion could be an artifact of a very small reference group rather than a batch-specific defect.
objections.result: CB-B-0917: p < 1e-300 after testing 7 hypotheses; Bonferroni alpha 1.4e-3

objections.objection: Geographic confounding is plausible; if the batch was deployed predominantly in one region with harsher operating conditions or different duty cycles, the effect may not be intrinsic to the batch itself.
objections.result: Within each warehouse CB-B-0917 still fails far more often (CMH p < 1e-300). Regional reporting habits cannot explain it.

objections.objection: The 1668x RR may be inflated by unmeasured usage patterns (e.g., charge cycles, depth of discharge) that correlate with the defect.
